title: The stunts nobody would insure
blurb: Buster Keaton, the silent comedian who did every stunt himself and never once smiled on camera. Four shorts and three features, in the order to watch them. Jackie Chan learned from these.

films.note: A newlywed builds a house from a kit. The kit has been sabotaged.
One man, every policeman in the city. The chase to end all chases.
Mistaken for a murderer because he looked through a window at the wrong moment.
Keaton plays every member of an orchestra and its entire audience.
Sherlock Jr.: a projectionist walks into the film he's showing. Uploaded as 'MyMovie'; the poster index worked out which film it was.
A Civil War locomotive chase, and the most expensive single shot of the silent era.
The house-front falls. He stands in the window. It's real.
